title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of borrowings by the Company of not exceeding $15,000,000 from the Massachusetts Industrial Finance Agency, the net proceeds of such borrowings to be used for the purpose of refinancing the costs of acquiring, constructing, and installing pollution control facilities at Mystic Generating Station and costs incidental thereto; and for approval by the Department of the issuance by the Company of not exceeding $15,000,000 principal amount Series U First Mortgage Bonds to evidence and secure such borrowings.
